Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov said that any form of “quasi-membership” for Ukraine in NATO would be “absolutely unacceptable” to Moscow. He made the statement in response to proposals to provide Kyiv with security guarantees modeled on NATO’s Article 5. According to Ryabkov, security guarantees can only be discussed if Ukraine accepts Russia’s demand that it never join NATO.
